description: Client schedule for mp_combat_net_rematch_smoke. A networked client goes back to its Room at stage end without an end screen (B-1190), so it waits for each match to go live instead.

input_sequence.comment: 60 s after the first match went live it has ended (35 s limit) and the client is in its Room; this waits for the host's second match.
50 s after the second match went live: past its 35 s limit, its stage end and the result lines.
